setup.native:
set -euo pipefail
source tools/godot/env.sh
export EMPIRE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS="${EMPIRE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-900}"
dotnet() { command timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15s "$EMPIRE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS" "$DOTNET_ROOT/dotnet" "$@"; }
export -f dotnet

stages.name: preflight-01
stages.command: python3 tools/godot/native-process-tests.py

stages.name: preflight-02
stages.command: python3 tools/godot/select-native-format-sources-tests.py

stages.name: preflight-03
stages.command: bash tools/godot/format-native.sh --check

stages.name: preflight-04
stages.command: python3 tools/godot/check-source-metadata.py

stages.name: preflight-05
stages.command: node tools/godot/validate-blackflag-camp.mjs --self-test

stages.name: preflight-06
stages.command: node tools/godot/validate-reed-village.mjs --self-test

stages.name: preflight-07
stages.command: node tools/godot/validate-white-river.mjs --self-test

stages.name: preflight-08
stages.command: node tools/godot/validate-luojia.mjs --self-test

stages.name: build-project
stages.command: dotnet build godot/Empire.csproj --disable-build-servers -m:1 -p:UseSharedCompilation=false

stages.name: build-core-tests
stages.command: dotnet build godot/Empire.Core.Tests --disable-build-servers -m:1 -p:UseSharedCompilation=false

stages.name: core-replay
stages.command:
EMPIRE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS="${EMPIRE_REPLAY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-1200}" \
  dotnet godot/Empire.Core.Tests/bin/Debug/net8.0/Empire.Core.Tests.dll godot/tests/oracle

stages.name: objective-outcome-checks
stages.command: bash tools/godot/objective-outcome-checks/run.sh

stages.name: catalog-boundary-checks
stages.command: bash tools/godot/catalog-boundary-checks/run.sh

stages.name: editor-import
stages.command:
import_log="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/empire-native-import.XXXXXX.log")"
bash tools/godot/native-process.sh "$import_log" 'Editor import' "$GODOT_NET" --headless --editor --path godot --import

stages.name: NarrativeChecks
stages.command:
run_scene() {
  local scene="$1" data log
  shift
  data="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/empire-native-check-data.XXXXXX")"
  log="$data/native.log"
  XDG_DATA_HOME="$data" bash tools/godot/native-process.sh "$log" "$scene" \
    "$GODOT_NET" --headless --path godot "res://Scenes/$scene.tscn" "$@"
}
export EMPIRE_NARRATIVE_EXPECTATIONS="$PWD/godot/tests/native/narrative.json"
scene=NarrativeChecks
run_scene "$scene"
